messageEn: An agent with this number already exists.

messageEn: An agent's phone is a desk phone or softphone (a SOFTPHONE SIP account).
messageSw: Simu ya wakala ni simu ya mezani au programu ya simu (akaunti ya SIP ya aina SOFTPHONE).

messageEn: Your desk phone is switched off in the admin. Ask your manager.
messageSw: Simu yako ya mezani imezimwa kwenye usimamizi. Muulize meneja wako.

messageSw: Namba hii ya nje haiwezi kupigwa kutoka hapa.
